primary.method: anonymous GET action=parse with fictional inputs; no edits
primary.normalization: Only newly inserted TH scope attributes and generated reference-call ids are omitted from table event comparison. Other attributes, tags, visible text, emphasis and citation targets are retained. Blank inter-tag whitespace is omitted.

dispositions: A recovered unterminated header attribute is not safe for scope insertion.
Line-reset bold markup inside distinct header cells retains the same native cells under scope insertion.
Two consecutive empty row markers can render the same native row structure after removing one marker. This pair does not authorize removing rows with attributes or contents.
Two identical DEFAULTSORT declarations have the same native effective value as one. Conflicting declarations retain last-winning priority.
